chunks: From his sayings (peace be upon him), when allegiance was sworn to him at Medina
And in it he informs the people with his knowledge of what their conditions will lead to, and in it he divides them into categories
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali inform the people about during his sermon in Medina after swearing allegiance?
ai.summary: This header introduces Imam Ali’s (AS) inaugural address in Medina, marking the transition from the Prophet’s era to the Caliphate and establishing his authority through both political legitimacy and esoteric knowledge. It underscores the Shia concept of *Ilm al-Ghayb* (knowledge of the unseen) granted to the Imam, as he categorizes the populace into distinct spiritual and political factions to predict their eventual fates. This classification serves as a prophetic framework for understanding the historical trajectory of the early Muslim community.

en.sayed-ali-raza: Delivered when allegiance was sworn to him at Medina
